name: Sculpfun S70 MAX 70W
tagline: 2025 flagship Sculpfun diode : 70W class on the S40/S70 large frame
tldr: Sculpfun's S70 MAX pushes the S-series frame to ~70W optical class for shops that want maximum diode cutting depth without CO₂. Same oversized bed philosophy as S40 MAX : premium pricing and workshop space requirements apply.
mainObjective: Top-tier Sculpfun large-format cutting with maximum diode power

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Strongest cut headroom in the line : about 8 mm basswood-class stock in benchmarks
70W: the most cut-focused head in the Sculpfun S70 MAX line
Open-frame : plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
Sculpfun S70 MAX: profile includes material limits, benchmarks, and practical notes on Maker Atlas
cons: Ultra-fine photo engraving may need slower settings than a 10W engraving-first module
Still a diode : clear acrylic production wants CO₂
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile covers Sculpfun S70 MAX 70W. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.
primaryUse: 2025 maximum-power Sculpfun for large-format cutting and high-throughput engraving.

editorialDepth.advantages: Sculpfun S70 MAX 70W targets mixed engraving and wood-cutting weeks : fewer passes on basswood and dark acrylic than weaker SKUs in the same line.
editorialDepth.limitations: Wrong pick if you never engrave and only wanted the lowest price. Ultra-fine photo work can look better on an engraving-first SKU. Open-frame : safety and smoke are on you.
